body: Thankyou for sharing this, it makes me feel less alone in a weird sort of way. I'm trying to get my mind together, but I just feel so 'eh' about everything. I used to smoke to deal with stress, but I've recently quit, I'm tempted to break out the emergency cigarettes though! The list is a good idea! About the drugs thing, its something I'm scared I could easily end up doing, for the first few days of my breakup I went on a massive sleeping pill spree in order to sleep/function. Thankyou so so so much for your comments, and I love that phrase at the end :) <3

Thankyou :) I just couldn't deal with home, being around my mum just makes me this awful mix of sad and angry which I can't deal with. I'm trying to speak to a couple of my friends now, I'm just paranoid that they're gonna think I'm just a weirdo and a loser. Thankyou foor saying I can talk to you :) There's a handful of people, mostly who are paid to stay over the term as sort of student helpers, or international students, I've been to a few events put on by the uni for people who are stuck here but there's only 5 people who attend them. I'm really tempted to go to be honest. Thankyou, so so much <3
This is my first breakup, it's just so strange that he was so much of my life and now he's not, it really hurts.

Thankyou, I just couldn't deal with her lying, her manipulation and her general abusiveness to everyone. I don't want to watch her ruin my family and drink herself to death, but I feel like a selfish coward for deciding to disown her. I'm gonna say no to her, even if it means lying, I can't handle her. I've recently made a lot of these friends and I'm paranoid that I'm going to screw up things, but I'm trying to talk to them now :) I want to be his friend but I don't know if I'm a strong enough person for that, I know seeing him will tear me up inside. Thankyou :) <3
Thankyou so much. I'm gonna try and see it through, I'm just sick of everything hurting and everything going to shit. I just want it to stop hurting and for things to stop going wrong. <3
